_doc: Shared BE/FE cases for the catalog an install-target prefill resolves from a version row: core/_catalogs.resolve_install_target_catalog with no explicit request catalog and no run default, and ui/lib/install-catalog.installTargetCatalog. home_cat is where the agent wrote the files, other_cat and third_cat are install catalogs.

cases.name: Dry Run draft: files only, never installed
kickstart: born with a files catalog and no install catalog
installed in another catalog: the install catalog, not the files
installed in two catalogs: uc_catalog is the latest open install
uninstalled: uc_catalog is only the last install location, so the files catalog
deployed row from before files catalogs: no files catalog, install catalog wins
deployed without an install catalog falls to the files catalog
nothing recorded: empty, the server then uses the installation catalog
